command: set -eu; SERIAL=$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1}' | sed -n '1p'); XML=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cat /sdcard/postconnect.xml 2>/dev/null || true); if ! printf '%s' "$XML" | grep -q 'meehow939@gmail.com' || [ "$(printf '%s' "$XML" | grep -o 'text="Granted"' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" -lt 2 ]; then echo 'NEEDS_USER_INTERACTION=1'; exit 0; fi; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am force-stop io.blueeye; sleep 1; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell monkey -p io.blueeye -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER 1 >/dev/null; sleep 1; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell input tap 75 160 || true; sleep 1; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/drawer2.xml >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; B=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cat /sdcard/drawer2.xml 2>/dev/null | python3 -c 'import sys,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET; s=sys.stdin.read(); r=ET.fromstring(s); n=next((x for x in r.iter() if x.attrib.get("text")=="Telemetry & AI Bridge"),None); print(n.attrib["bounds"] if n is not None else "")' || true); if [ -n "$B" ]; then XY=$(printf '%s' "$B" | python3 -c 'import sys,re; a=list(map(int,re.findall(r"\d+",sys.stdin.read()))); print((a[0]+a[2])//2,(a[1]+a[3])//2)'); set -- $XY; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell input tap "$1" "$2"; sleep 3; fi; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/restart.xml >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; echo '--- AFTER FORCE-STOP RESTART ---'; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cat /sdcard/restart.xml 2>/dev/null | sed 's/></>\n</g' | grep -E 'meehow939|Drive file scope|Gmail send scope|Granted|Not granted|Connect Google account|Change Google account|Restoring Google authorization|reconnection' | head -180 || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cat /sdcard/restart.xml 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'meehow939@gmail.com'; test "$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cat /sdcard/restart.xml 2>/dev/null | grep -o 'text="Granted"' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" -ge 2; echo SILENT_RESTORE_PASS=1
